name: trade-alert-next
description: Trade Alert System - Flutter, Backend, and Web Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:flutter"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../web-dashboard && npm install && cd ../flutter && flutter pub get
scripts.clean: cd backend && npm run clean && cd ../web-dashboard && rm -rf .next node_modules && cd ../flutter && flutter clean
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:flutter
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:flutter
